## Caveats

- The PR description’s October 29 update says the delegate discriminator is optional and has a legacy example omitting it, but the frozen HEAD source patch declares `subagent_type` required on the base and delegate models. A later reply says the new hierarchy requires it while the service still treats omission as `delegate`; this does not establish schema compatibility for old payloads. Prefer the source patch for current declarations and retain this disagreement as unresolved.
- Review guidance about aliases was conditional on spread-only use. The subsequent final source instead defines `VoiceAgentVoiceConfig` as a model and extends it for session settings; neither approach is a blanket rule for all reuse.
- The final source contains an explicit suppression for known-encoding on integer-millisecond duration fields. The response reports no tests run by this extraction; validation statements in the PR description and comments are attributed claims, not independently performed checks. Service compatibility claims do not prove schema compatibility.
